svg.text: Looking straight into the socket on the robot, with the slot in the cover on the right (same orientation as the photo).
• Verify before wiring: pins 1 & 2 read battery voltage against pin 6/7; pins 6 & 7 have continuity to battery (−).
• iRobot's spec drawing is rotated 90° from this view. Use the notch beside pin 6 as the reference.
• Making a plug? Seen from its solder side, a male Mini-DIN matches this picture. Its pin face is the mirror image.
